purpose: Concrete production-port inventory for the accepted scene. Metadata only: runtime modules do not fetch or enforce this manifest.
pathBase: All files[].path, assetPaths, portraitPath, audioPath and imagePath resolve relative to prototype dist/. sourceFiles resolve relative to prototype root.

scope.excludes: Historical/unreferenced rasters, unavailable classic portraits, unused programme painting, unused Series pieces and a fabricated first-feed cover are excluded. Source provenance can describe historical files without making them dependencies.

phases.welcome-compact: Only the compact welcome poster at boot; keep a deterministic fallback while selected art settles.
phases.welcome-desktop: Only the registered desktop welcome poster at boot; a cold resize into compact first arms the compact poster and keeps a coherent fallback until ready.
phases.welcome-fonts: Text remains usable while relevant script/style fonts settle.
phases.cabinet-entry: Production target: arm cabinet art after entry intent. The prototype retains its shared cabinet art in the initial readiness set and decodes repeated sources once.
phases.classics: Arm only selected-language eligible portrait set when classics is needed.
phases.discovery-series: Prepare the same panorama/painting and one selected silent piece.
phases.discovery-letters: Prepare room, wood and mail materials only for the current or deliberately next scene.
phases.discovery-calendar: Prepare selected live calendar sheet; no separate programme artwork.
phases.series-current-and-next: Selected-piece current image plus its next image, not the full catalogue.
phases.series-sound-gesture: Reader-initiated audio only; stop/release on leave.

priorities.critical: Relevant current-branch visible art/text; failures and reduced motion must still expose controls.
priorities.next-scene: Bounded deliberate handoff; cannot hold an unrelated current scene.
priorities.scene-local: Load when this scene/selected piece is needed; current+one-next warm window.
priorities.gesture-only: No audio construction/download before a reader sound gesture.

policies.readiness: Downloading is not decoding. Resolve success, failure, timeout and route cancellation exactly once. Late completions may not revive an inactive scene.
policies.motion: Keep established v44 flight geometry and endpoints; reduced motion settles the same destination. Cancel owned effects/timers/listeners and recover from missing/stalled WAAPI completion.
policies.cache: Deduplicate by exact source URL and share physical cover decode across repeated book nodes; listing an asset does not authorize boot preloading.
policies.productionDerivatives: The source inventory is not an optimized responsive delivery set. Generate tested lower-resolution renditions for actual scene sizes, preserve logical geometry, assign sizes/srcset or equivalent and verify decoded/compositor memory on physical devices.
policies.firstFeedCover: Resolve the actual first canonical Worker slate, freeze bok identity through flight, and fetch its real cover dynamically; this manifest does not nominate a prototype story.

geometry.units: Logical CSS scene units unless a field explicitly states normalized values or physical pixels.

foregroundTable.note: Apply as a fixed aperture in scene coordinates at front x=420, y=604. It reveals the original foreground table above the sliding panel without adding furniture.

desktopWelcome.fit: Cover anchored to right cabinet edge and floor. Moving glass and extension crop the same raster; no second door image.

series.canvas: Per-piece logical canvas, crop focal points, normalized safeZones and timing below. Preserve original manifest text/timing outside this metadata inventory.

classicArchive.sourcePolicy: Use the corrected user-supplied archive as requested. Its status and identity fields are recorded as supplied, not independently verified. Many files are labelled generated in that metadata; they are not represented as unchanged historical photographs.
classicArchive.transformations: None: exact supplied 512×512 WebP bytes. No new images were generated in this revision.
classicArchive.verification: Each of the 42 eligible portrait files matches the supplied archive hash and byte count; archive status/identity is supplied metadata, not independent historical or rights verification.
